title: Book Two · Chapter 116: A Different Table
story:
Thursday brings a new reading task. Miss Wu places a short story and two picture cards on each table. The pupils can choose pairs.

Ronan keeps the chair beside him empty. He does not put his bag there. He watches the doorway.

Jun enters with his tree book in its plain cover. He looks at the tables, then sits beside another boy. They pull the two picture cards between them.

Leo sits at Ronan's table.

“Is this free?”

“Yes.”

Leo takes the empty chair. He puts the story sideways.

“Now you cannot begin before me.”

Ronan turns his own head to read it. Leo laughs and turns the paper back.

The story is about a woman and a parcel. The woman carries the parcel to a house. Nobody opens the door. She takes it to the shop next door and leaves a note at the house.

Ronan reads quickly at first. Then he stops at two short lines.

SHE PUTS THE NOTE UNDER THE DOOR. SHE LEAVES IT THERE.

“Is that the parcel or the note?” Leo asks.

“The parcel,” Ronan says. He reads the line before it. “No. Wait. The note is under the door.”

Leo puts a finger beside the shop in the picture.

“Then the parcel is here.”

They read both lines together. They choose the right card and explain the route in four short steps.

Miss Wu comes around. She asks Ronan where the woman leaves the note. He names the place clearly.

“Under the house door.”

She makes a small mark on the task sheet and moves on.

Across the room, Jun is laughing. His partner has drawn the parcel bigger than the house. Jun points at it and spreads both hands.

Ronan feels a small ache behind his ribs. Jun can still enjoy a reading task. Jun has chosen a different partner. They can laugh together too.

Leo asks him to read the last question.

“Why does the woman leave a note?”

“So the man can find his parcel.”

“Good. I want one for my lunch. My lunch keeps going away.”

“You eat it.”

“That is a strong reason.”

Ronan laughs. His laugh surprises him. He reads the question to Leo again. Then he writes their answer.

After class, Jun passes their table. He sees the two cards in the correct order.

“Is that the shop one?”

“Yes,” Ronan says.

Jun nods. Then he goes to return his own cards.

Jun has asked about this story. He has not asked to work with Ronan again. Ronan puts his own story page in the return tray and gives Leo back his pencil.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

parcel＝包裹；note＝便条；partner＝搭档；return tray＝归还托盘。

## 理解问题

1. Jun这次坐在谁旁边？
2. Ronan和Leo怎样确认便条留在哪里、包裹放在哪里？

## 读句子

**Leo / takes / the empty chair.** Leo／坐到／空椅子上。
